english.fullText: Stop LLM Hallucinations with RAG Architecture Retrieval-Augmented Generation connects private enterprise data to modern LLMs. Documents are transformed into dense vector embeddings and stored in Pinecone and Milvus. Factual accuracy increases by 85% with sub-second 180ms retrieval latency. Document Chunking, Hybrid Vector Retrieval, and Prompt Context Augmentation. RAG is now the production standard for enterprise generative AI applications.
